best_hook.why: A priest lying bare-chested in a woman's bed says 'A man in my collar isn't supposed to be in this bed at all': the forbidden affair is clear at once.

best_cliffhanger.why: The maid sees the affair through the doorway and freezes in shock, and the clip cuts before anyone knows they've been seen or what she will do.

must_promos.why: Opens on the corrupt priest's line 'Absolution is free. Discretion has a price.', runs through the bribe deal and the passionate embrace, and ends on the maid stumbling onto them and gasping.
A scandalous in-bed opening, 'Name your price', the outrageous tax-territory demand, and a cut on the blackmail line before Catherine agrees.

standalone_risk: A stranger won't know that Agnes is Catherine's own maid and accomplice, so it is unclear why her discovery is dangerous. The hearing and the 'west territory' deal also lack context.
notes: The discovery is only about 8 seconds at the very end, so the strongest cut has to run about 49 s from the mid-episode hook to reach it.
